# Third-party source snapshots

These directories contain copied, pinned source snapshots. They are not Git submodules or forks, and this repository has no upstream remote.

- `np21w/`: Neko Project 21/W rev104 BSD-only source, with its license notices preserved. The separate `np2tool/` utilities and source package `.gitignore` were omitted.
- `ymfm/`: ymfm at commit `81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a`, with its BSD-3-Clause license preserved. Its source package `.gitignore` was omitted.

See [source import](../docs/source-import.md) for URLs, hashes, dates, and verification status. Do not replace these snapshots through a Git remote or automated sync.
